evals.prompt: Prepare the retro for this sprint.
evals.expected_output: Pack with the minimum set of inherited metrics and themes as questions.
expectations: The factual context includes reliability by count, carryover, scope change, velocity vs average and number of flagged
The themes are phrased as neutral questions, not as verdicts
The agenda has timeboxes totaling ~60 min across the five phases
Creating tickets for the actions only happens on request and with approval

evals.prompt: The team is coming off a bad sprint and is demoralized. Prepare the retro.
evals.expected_output: Suitable format and anonymous collection proposed.
expectations: Proposes anonymous collection as the mechanism
Justifies the choice by tying it to the team's moment
The themes do not blame people

evals.prompt: Half the team is in another time zone. How do I prepare the retro?
expectations: The synchronous session focuses on insights and actions, not on collecting

evals.prompt: There are 12 of us in the retro. Prepare the session.
expectations: Indicates breakouts for the gather phase since there are more than ~8 people
Suggests silent writing or an equivalent mechanism so a few voices do not dominate
The agenda still reserves real time to decide actions

evals.prompt: Prepare the continuous-flow retro for the Kanban board.
evals.expected_output: Pack with factual flow context and themes channeled to wait/WIP/lead time.
expectations: The factual context includes lead time, cycle time, throughput, WIP per column and blocked/wait age
The output recognizes that the retro is continuous-flow and not sprint-based
The themes are phrased as neutral questions focused on flow
